source.command: python -m pytest tests/test_antigravity_minimax_adapter.py tests/test_dispatcher.py tests/test_operator.py tests/test_antigravity_adapter.py tests/test_codex_adapter.py -q

claims.claim: Operator Human-facing and wakeup/correction admission surfaces accept exactly the new antigravity-minimax executor wherever a coding Executor is already accepted, while invalid executor identities still fail closed and existing Codex/Antigravity behavior is unchanged.

Dispatcher resolves antigravity-minimax through the existing native adapter registry for PRIMARY, REMEDIATION, and REPAIR, preserves selected-executor/RUN identity, and invokes at most one adapter with no fallback or second dispatch on construction, native, or output failure.

Thin AntigravityMinimaxAdapter invokes the external agym transport with --output-format json, bound workspace, explicit AIOS mode, explicit operation, explicit response schema path, and bounded response/process watchdogs, never passing MiniMax credentials or provider URLs on the command line.

AntigravityMinimaxAdapter supports deterministic success fixtures for PRIMARY, REMEDIATION, and all three admitted REPAIR action outcomes (CODE_FIX, NO_CHANGE, CONTINUE_IMPLEMENTATION), returning structural ResultPackage through existing validators without treating agym prose as canonical truth.

Success coverage proves transport workspace/HEAD observations are bound consistently to the admitted execution and returned Result head, while agym changed_files diagnostics neither replace nor alter Result.changed_files or Runtime-derived repository truth.

AntigravityMinimaxAdapter fails closed on missing executable, process timeout, nonzero process exit, malformed JSON, schema violation, PASS/exit-code disagreement, dirty refusal, State Guard violation, workspace/head mismatch, missing or prose-wrapped response, and structurally invalid ResultPackage.

AntigravityMinimaxAdapter preserves TASK-092 REPAIR instruction semantics without dropping CONTINUE_IMPLEMENTATION instructions or inventing conflicting repair actions, leaving existing Codex and Antigravity adapter regressions green.

Frozen Kernel v0.1 specification and freeze records (docs/AIOS-RENEW-KERNEL-v0.1-*) remain byte-unchanged; antigravity-minimax is admitted as a prospective post-freeze product extension without editing the v0.1 freeze baseline.
Focused regression suites verify the new adapter, Dispatcher, and Operator admission surfaces without modifying untracked files outside the authorized task scope.
